subgroups.name: solve 3

steps.hints: ❓ Did you change the order of the code blocks so that the strawberry sprite does not appear until the end?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓What blocks need to be moved so that the strawberry sprite does not appear until the very end?


Solution: 

The strawberry sprite’s [set sprite to] and [set sprite position to] blocks need to be moved to the end of the project, before the final [show long text], [start screen effect], and [play sound] blocks.

﻿
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, the strawberry sprite appears at the beginning of the project. That doesn’t make sense if the bat is searching for fruit!


Change only the code needed to fix the bug so that the strawberry sprite does not appear until after the bat has found it!
